text: 创业板指、科创50均涨超1%，沪指涨0.15%，深成指涨0.5%，AI应用、算力硬件、先进封装等方向领涨，沪深京三市上涨个股超3200只。
text_en: ChiNext and STAR 50 both rose over 1%, with the Shanghai Composite up 0.15% and the Shenzhen Component up 0.5%. AI applications, computing hardware and advanced packaging led gains, with over 3,200 stocks rising across Shanghai, Shenzhen and Beijing.
